name: codex-monitor-overlay
description: A native high-DPI Codex quota orb for macOS and Windows with authoritative weekly quota, current context capacity, and local token-history details.

interface.shortDescription: Live Codex quota orb with a detailed token-history view.
interface.longDescription: Shows authoritative Codex weekly remaining quota in a draggable native macOS or Windows orb, then opens current-session context capacity and local daily, weekly, and cumulative token-history views directly from the quota area.
interface.defaultPrompt: 打开 Codex 配额悬浮球。
